cards.english_title: America’s Midterms Bring a Wave of Historic Firsts
cards.korean_desc: 유권자들은 2026년 11월 3일 역사적 후보들을 뽑았다. 승리로 여성, 흑인, 무슬림, 게이 남성이 높은 자리에 올랐다. 키샤 랜스 바텀스가 조지아 첫 흑인 여성 주지사가 됐다. 뎁 할랜드가 뉴멕시코 첫 원주민 여성 주지사가 됐다. 압둘 엘사예드는 미국 첫 무슬림 상원의원이 된다.
cards.english_desc: Voters elected historic candidates across America on November 3, 2026. Their wins opened offices long closed to women, Black Americans, Muslims and openly gay men. Keisha Lance Bottoms became Georgia’s first Black woman governor. Deb Haaland became New Mexico’s first Native American female governor. Abdul El-Sayed will become America’s first Muslim senator.
cards.hook: America’s midterms brought a wave of historic firsts.
cards.takeaway_english: The new leaders now face pressure to turn symbolic breakthroughs into policy.
cards.takeaway_korean: 새 지도자들은 이제 상징을 정책으로 바꿔야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: New leaders may influence healthcare, costs, representation and national priorities.
why_it_matters.korean: 새 지도자들이 의료와 물가를 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: More groups now see people like themselves entering powerful offices.
why_it_matters.korean: 더 많은 사람들이 자신과 같은 지도자를 본다.

parties.label: Democrats
parties.english: They won key races and are positioned to regain major power in Congress.

parties.label: Historic candidates
parties.english: Their victories break racial, religious, gender and sexuality barriers in national politics.

parties.label: Republicans
parties.english: They lost important races, including Georgia’s governorship and several Senate seats.

views.label: The Hindu
views.english: The results show a blue wave and a remarkable series of historic firsts.

views.label: Associated Press
views.english: Democrats won power, but many voters still remain skeptical of the party.

disagree.english: Some observers may see rejection of Republicans more than strong support for Democrats.
disagree.korean: 일부는 민주당 지지보다 공화당 거부로 본다.

cards.english_title: Trump’s Aid Cut Puts U.S.-Israel Ties Under Strain
cards.korean_desc: 그는 결정을 공화당 선거 부담과 엘사예드 선거에 연결했다. 엘사예드는 미국 군사 원조 반대를 상원 선거 핵심으로 삼았다. 11월 4일 엘사예드는 미시간에서 이겨 첫 무슬림 상원의원이 됐다.
cards.english_desc: He linked the decision to Republican election costs, especially El-Sayed’s Michigan campaign. El-Sayed made opposition to American military aid central to his Senate campaign. On November 4, El-Sayed won Michigan and became the first Muslim U.S. senator.
cards.hook: Trump announced an end to about $4 billion in yearly aid.
cards.korean_hook: 트럼프가 연간 약 40억 달러 원조를 끊겠다고 했다
cards.takeaway_english: The announcement signals that support for Israel is now a sharper American election issue.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이스라엘 지원은 이제 미국 선거의 큰 쟁점이다.

why_it_matters.english: American taxpayers may see a major change in how money supports foreign military policy.
why_it_matters.korean: 미국 납세자는 해외 군사정책 지원 변화를 보게 된다.

why_it_matters.english: The decision could affect Israel’s military planning and U.S. diplomacy.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 이스라엘 군사계획과 미국 외교에 영향을 준다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He announced that annual U.S. military aid to Israel would end by year’s end.
parties.korean: 트럼프는 이스라엘 군사 원조를 끝내겠다고 했다.

parties.label: Israel
parties.english: Israel faces a possible loss of major American military support.
parties.korean: 이스라엘은 미국의 큰 지원을 잃을 수 있다.

parties.label: Abdul El-Sayed
parties.english: His opposition to aid helped make the issue important in Michigan’s Senate race.
parties.korean: 엘사예드는 원조 반대를 선거 쟁점으로 만들었다.

views.label: Trump administration
views.english: The aid had become an electoral liability for Republicans.

views.label: Israeli government
views.english: Supporters of Israel argue that American military backing remains strategically important.
views.korean: 이스라엘 지지자들은 미국 지원이 전략적으로 중요하다고 본다.

disagree.english: Critics may say the announcement was electoral messaging, while supporters may call it policy correction.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 선거용 발언, 지지자들은 정책 수정이라고 할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Amish Shah Flips Arizona Seat for Democrats
cards.korean_desc: 아미시 샤는 2026년 11월 4일 애리조나 1구에서 이겼다. 민주당 샤가 전 NFL 선수 공화당 제이 필리를 이겼다. 샤는 52.49%, 필리는 45.45%를 받았다. 그는 이제 미국 하원의 여섯 번째 인도계 의원이다.
cards.english_desc: Amish Shah won Arizona’s First Congressional District on November 4, 2026. The Democrat defeated Republican Jay Feely, a former National Football League player. Shah received 52.49% of votes, while Feely received 45.45%. He is now the sixth Indian-American elected to the U.S. House.
cards.hook: Amish Shah became Arizona’s first Indian-American congressman.
cards.korean_hook: 아미시 샤가 애리조나 첫 인도계 의원이 됐다
cards.takeaway_english: Shah’s first test will be turning campaign promises into results for a competitive district.
cards.takeaway_korean: 샤의 첫 시험은 선거 약속을 성과로 바꾸는 일이다.

why_it_matters.english: The district now has a representative promising action on healthcare and household costs.
why_it_matters.korean: 지역 주민은 의료와 생활비 해결을 약속한 의원을 얻었다.

why_it_matters.english: His election adds another Indian-American voice to Congress.
why_it_matters.korean: 그의 당선으로 의회에 인도계 목소리가 늘었다.

parties.label: Amish Shah
parties.english: He won Arizona’s First Congressional District and flipped a Republican-held seat.
parties.korean: 샤는 애리조나 1구를 이겨 공화당 의석을 바꿨다.

parties.label: Jay Feely
parties.english: The Republican former NFL player lost the close race after Trump endorsed him.
parties.korean: 공화당 후보 제이 필리는 접전에서 졌다.

parties.label: Arizona voters
parties.english: They chose a doctor and former state legislator to represent the district.

views.label: Amish Shah
views.english: He emphasized lowering costs, expanding healthcare coverage, water and economic growth.
views.korean: 샤는 물가, 의료, 물, 경제를 강조했다.

views.label: Indian American Impact
views.english: The group said he reached voters through conversations about unaffordable healthcare and rising costs.
views.korean: 단체는 그가 의료비와 물가를 이야기했다고 했다.

disagree.english: Some voters may have focused more on party control than Shah’s community background.
disagree.korean: 일부 유권자는 배경보다 정당을 더 중시했을 수 있다.

cards.korean_desc: 수하스 수브라마냠과 피아 단디야는 11월 3일 하원에 당선됐다. 두 사람의 승리는 의회에 인도계 목소리를 더했다. 비벡 라마스와미는 민주당 에이미 액턴에게 졌다.
cards.english_desc: Suhas Subramanyam and Pia Dandiya won House seats on November 3. Their victories added Indian-American voices to Congress. Vivek Ramaswamy lost Ohio’s governor race to Democrat Amy Acton.
cards.hook: Two Indian-American Democrats won House seats; Vivek Ramaswamy lost.
cards.korean_hook: 인도계 민주당원 둘은 이겼고 라마스와미는 졌다
cards.takeaway_english: Indian-American representation grew, but the political map remained mixed.

why_it_matters.english: More diverse lawmakers can bring different community concerns into Congress.
why_it_matters.korean: 더 다양한 의원들이 지역 문제를 의회에 가져온다.

why_it_matters.english: The results show that identity did not guarantee one party’s success.
why_it_matters.korean: 정체성만으로 한 정당의 승리를 보장하지 못했다.

parties.english: He won reelection in Virginia’s 10th congressional district.

parties.label: Vivek Ramaswamy

parties.korean: 비벡 라마스와미는 오하이오 주지사 선거에서 졌다.

views.label: Business Standard
views.english: The results showed a mixed outcome for Indian-American candidates.
views.korean: 결과는 인도계 미국 후보들의 혼합된 성적을 보여줬다.

views.label: New Indian Express
views.english: The wins reflected growing political participation among Indian Americans.
views.korean: 승리는 인도계 미국인의 정치 참여를 보여줬다.

disagree.english: Others may see the races as separate contests rather than evidence of one community-wide trend.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 각 선거를 별개의 경쟁으로 볼 수 있다.

cards.korean_title: 밴스, 공화당 패배에서 자기 길을 찾다
cards.english_title: Vance Blames Trump’s Iran War After Republican Rout
cards.korean_desc: 그는 이란 전쟁, 물가, 미국의 우선순위를 지적했다. 그의 주장은 트럼프와 거리를 두면서 미국 우선 정치에 남았다. 패배는 2028년 공화당 후보 경쟁 전 밴스의 입지를 강화했다. 다음 싸움은 공화당이 밴스와 트럼프 중 누구를 따를지다.
cards.english_desc: He singled out the Iran war, living costs and America’s priorities. His argument publicly separated him from Trump while staying inside America First politics. The loss strengthened Vance’s position before the 2028 Republican nomination contest. The next fight is whether Republicans follow Vance or defend Trump’s direction.
cards.hook: Vance blamed Trump’s policies for the Republican rout.
cards.korean_hook: 밴스가 공화당 패배를 트럼프 정책 탓으로 돌렸다
cards.takeaway_english: Vance’s break from Trump may be the beginning of a new Republican succession fight.
cards.takeaway_korean: 밴스의 거리두기는 공화당 후계 경쟁의 시작일 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The dispute could shape Republican leadership before the 2028 presidential race.
why_it_matters.korean: 논쟁은 2028년 대선 전 공화당 지도부를 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: War and living costs are now tied directly to the party’s election problem.
why_it_matters.korean: 전쟁과 물가가 공화당 선거 문제와 직접 연결됐다.

parties.label: J.D. Vance
parties.english: He said the administration abandoned America First politics and blamed the Iran war.
parties.korean: 밴스는 행정부가 미국 우선 정치를 버렸다고 했다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: His policies and war with Iran became targets of Republican criticism after the losses.
parties.korean: 트럼프의 정책과 이란 전쟁이 공화당 비판을 받았다.

parties.label: Marco Rubio
parties.english: The Republican rout weakened his prospects as a possible 2028 nominee.

views.label: J.D. Vance
views.english: He argued that war, living costs and misplaced priorities drove voters away.
views.korean: 밴스는 전쟁과 물가가 유권자를 떠나게 했다고 봤다.

views.label: Other Republicans
views.english: Some Republicans may see the result as a broader rejection of Trump’s leadership.
views.korean: 일부 공화당원은 트럼프 지도력의 거부로 본다.

disagree.english: Others may argue that Democrats benefited from normal midterm backlash, not only Republican policy failures.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 민주당이 중간선거 역풍의 도움을 받았다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 밴스는 다른 공화당 정체성을 만들 수 있습니까?

cards.english_title: Democrats Take Congress After Trump’s Midterm Defeat
cards.korean_desc: 민주당은 2026년 11월 3일 양원을 이겼다. 유권자들은 생활비와 연료비, 이란 전쟁에 화났다. 민주당은 캔자스와 텍사스에서도 의석을 뒤집었다. 11월 4일 현재 최종 투표율은 불확실했다.
cards.english_desc: Democrats won the House and Senate on November 3, 2026. Voters were angry about living costs, fuel prices and the Iran war. Democrats flipped seats in traditionally Republican states, including Kansas and Texas. As of November 4, final turnout and the House majority size remained unclear.
cards.hook: Democrats won both chambers after a sweeping upset.
cards.takeaway_english: The result shifts Washington from one-party control toward open confrontation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 결과로 워싱턴의 대립이 커질 전망이다.

why_it_matters.english: Congress can now block parts of the president’s agenda.
why_it_matters.korean: 의회는 대통령 정책 일부를 막을 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Investigations into the administration may become more likely.
why_it_matters.korean: 정부 조사가 더 많아질 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: High prices and fuel costs shaped a major national vote.
why_it_matters.korean: 높은 물가와 연료비가 전국 선거를 좌우했다.

parties.label: Democrats
parties.english: They gained control of both the House and Senate.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: His party lost control after voters focused on prices, war and corruption concerns.
parties.korean: 트럼프의 당은 물가와 전쟁 문제로 패했다.

parties.label: American voters
parties.english: Their votes created a stronger check on the president’s agenda.

views.label: Associated Press
views.english: Young and Hispanic voters helped Democrats break through in Republican-leaning areas.

views.label: Axios
views.english: Cost of living and corruption were leading concerns, alongside the Iran war.
views.korean: 생활비와 부패, 이란 전쟁이 주요 걱정이었다.

disagree.english: Some Republicans may argue the result reflected local races more than a national judgment on Trump.
disagree.korean: 일부 공화당원은 지역 선거 결과라고 주장할 수 있다.

sentences.english: Democrats won the House and Senate on November 3, 2026.
sentences.korean: 민주당은 2026년 11월 3일 양원을 이겼다.

sentences.english: Voters were angry about living costs, fuel prices and the Iran war.
sentences.korean: 유권자들은 생활비와 연료비, 이란 전쟁에 화났다.

sentences.english: Democrats flipped seats in traditionally Republican states, including Kansas and Texas.
sentences.korean: 민주당은 캔자스와 텍사스에서도 의석을 뒤집었다.

sentences.english: As of November 4, final turnout and the House majority size remained unclear.
sentences.korean: 11월 4일 현재 최종 투표율은 불확실했다.
